name: Taiga Shinjirou
source: He is the primary protagonist of Sakura Taisen 5, and nephew of Ichiro Ogami. He is hardworking and dedicated to the samurai spirit, but is somewhat straightforward, which leads to problems. Shinjiro loves and honors his mother and frequently sends letters to her.
